summary: A pre-CCC 14 by 14 foot R4-D8 cab on Chicken Peak in the Frank Church Wilderness, built about 1930, last staffed in 1969, and still standing.

facts.design: 14 by 14 foot R4-D8 cab, a pre-CCC design with a wooden body, steep pyramid roof and no catwalk
facts.status_note: Abandoned since 1969 and still standing; the register calls it a cultural treasure needing care

access.note: A hike-in inside the Frank Church - River of No Return Wilderness, per Idaho Fire Lookouts. No source read says whether the cabin may be entered or climbed.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in. Firelookout.com places it about 12 miles north of Big Creek R.S. No trail distance appears in the sources read.

events.note: Register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Keeping Watch give 1930; Forest Lookouts says early 1930s, a native log ground cabin with a corrugated sheet metal roof

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Keeping Watch and Forest Lookouts date the cabin to 1930 or the early 1930s. Firelookout.com alone says 1933, so 1930 is used. The 1933 date is recorded as an event.
The register gives 8,608 ft (2,624 m). Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 8657 feet. The register figure is used because it matches the brief's elevation_m of 2623.7.

notes_for_editor: Build year is 1930 in four sources and 1933 on firelookout.com, which may be a copy of the Burton Peak cabin's date (also 14x14 and 1933); this is not confirmed. Elevation differs: 8,608 ft in the register, 8657 feet on the two other sites. No staffing names were found; Idaho Fire Lookouts says none are documented. The 2021 Dixie Jumbo Fire material is in Keeping Watch's collection; no source read says the fire reached the cabin, so the story does not say so. The hike-in is inside the wilderness and no trail distance was found; check with the Payette National Forest before publishing visit advice. Keeping Watch pages carry images with no direct image URLs, so no photo entries were added.
